name: GCAT Global Concierge Airport Transfers
author: neilduffyau

sections.description:
GCAT Global Concierge Airport Transfers lets a transfer, shuttle or private-car business take bookings on its own WordPress site.

  • Booking form with instant quotes: one way or return, pick-up and drop-off, extra stops, date and time, passengers, suitcases and child seats.
  • Vehicles with passenger and luggage limits. Vehicles that do not fit the group are shown as unavailable.
  • Zones and zone fares: fixed prices between areas (for example Airport to City centre), per vehicle, one way or both ways.
  • Distance pricing (optional): base fare + price per km or mile, minimum fare and per-vehicle multipliers, using your own Google Maps Platform key.
  • Extra-stop pricing: each stop is charged by how far out of the way it is, in bands you set (for example 0-5 km, 6-10 km, 11-15 km, 16 km and over), or a flat fee per stop.
  • Return trips with an optional return discount, after-hours surcharge and child seat fees.
  • Booking records in the admin with statuses: Pending, Awaiting payment, Confirmed, “AI Confirm, pls manual check”, Completed and Cancelled, a status filter and a booking history log.
  • Email notifications to the customer and to you, with editable templates and placeholders, plus optional status-change emails.
  • Dashboard with status counts, this month’s confirmed revenue and the next 7 days of jobs.
  • Block and shortcode: add the “GCAT Global Concierge Airport Transfers” block or [gcat_transfer_booking] to any page.
  • Privacy tools: bookings are included in WordPress personal data export and erasure, with suggested privacy-policy text.
  • Pay later / manual payments built in, with a payments interface that other gateways can plug into.
  • AI setup assistant (WordPress 7.0 and later): uses the built-in WordPress AI Client and whichever AI provider you have connected in Settings > Connectors. Describe your business in plain words. The assistant proposes vehicles, zones, fares, pricing rules, form options and email templates. Nothing is saved until you review and click Apply.

The price is always recalculated on the server when a booking is submitted.

External services

This plugin can connect to the following third-party service. It is not contacted until you switch the feature on and enter your own API key.

Google Maps Platform – Routes API (optional distance pricing)

Used to measure driving distance for trips that have no zone fare, and for extra-stop detours. Only when “Enable distance pricing” is on and a key is saved. When a visitor asks for a quote, the pick-up, drop-off and extra-stop addresses they typed and your API key are sent from your server to https://routes.googleapis.com. Results are cached for 12 hours.
Terms: https://cloud.google.com/maps-platform/terms – Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

AI setup assistant (optional, WordPress 7.0 and later)

This plugin does not connect to any AI service itself and does not store AI keys. The assistant uses the WordPress AI Client built into WordPress 7.0 and later, through the AI provider and credentials you configured in Settings > Connectors. Only when an administrator sends a message on the AI assistant screen, the message, the conversation so far and the current booking settings (vehicles, zones, fares, pricing, form and email templates) are passed to the WordPress AI Client, which sends them to your connected provider under that provider’s terms and privacy policy. Bookings, customer details and API keys are never sent.

Hooks for developers

Actions: gcatglco_loaded, gcatglco_booking_created, gcatglco_booking_ready, gcatglco_booking_status_changed, gcatglco_dashboard_before, gcatglco_dashboard_after, gcatglco_booking_details_after, gcatglco_payments_settings, gcatglco_settings_tab_{tab}, gcatglco_save_settings_tab_{tab}.

Filters: gcatglco_quote, gcatglco_quote_vehicle, gcatglco_distance_meters, gcatglco_payment_gateways, gcatglco_statuses, gcatglco_email, gcatglco_email_placeholders, gcatglco_status_email_statuses, gcatglco_pre_create_booking, gcatglco_settings_tabs, gcatglco_form_html, gcatglco_form_allowed_html, gcatglco_quote_rate_limit, gcatglco_booking_rate_limit, gcatglco_is_pro.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the gcat-global-concierge-airport-transfers folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the zip from Plugins > Add New > Upload.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Transfers > Settings and set your vehicles, zones, zone fares and pricing rules (or use Transfers > AI assistant).
  4. Add the “GCAT Global Concierge Airport Transfers” block, or the [gcat_transfer_booking] shortcode, to a page.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Google Maps key?

No. With zone fares only, the plugin makes no external requests. A key is needed only for distance pricing and distance-based extra-stop fees. Without it, extra stops use the flat fee.

Can customers pay online?

This version records bookings as “pay later / manual”. Developers can add a gateway by extending GCATGLCO_Gateway and using the gcatglco_payment_gateways filter.

What does “AI Confirm, pls manual check” mean?

It is a status for bookings that an automated or AI channel created and that a person should check before confirming. It does not affect payments or emails.

Does uninstalling delete my bookings?

Settings are always removed. Bookings are only deleted if you tick “Delete all bookings on uninstall” under Transfers > Settings > General.
